title: Identify Attack Surfaces
prompt: Classify each situation into the correct vulnerability / attack surface category.

items.label: Server whose vendor has ended all support
Critical patch available for six months but never applied
Unpatched VMs allowing lateral movement between guests
Flaw unknown to the vendor, with no patch available
File checked then replaced before opening (time-of-check / time-of-use)
API password hardcoded in plaintext in the source code
Error message displaying the SQL query and server path
Forgotten service account with administrator privileges
SaaS application used by teams without security approval
Rogue Wi-Fi access point installed in the office
Internal chatbot accepting instructions embedded in an uploaded document
Object storage bucket accidentally made publicly accessible

explain: Separate the nature of the weakness: system (end-of-support, patching, VM, zero-day), code (TOCTOU, secrets, exception handling), identity/configuration (credentials, shadow IT, rogue device), and modern surfaces (LLMs, public cloud storage).
